description: Session posture for expensive orchestrator models (Fable/Opus): /advisor puts the main agent into a delegation-only mode - it writes specs, dispatches cheaper implementer agents, personally reviews spec compliance and quality by default (cross-provider review is opt-in), triages findings, and merges, while a hard PreToolUse gate (exit 2, bypass-surviving) blocks its own file edits and non-orchestration Bash. Subagent calls pass untouched; a per-turn posture injection keeps the model delegating instead of fighting denials. ADVISOR_DIRECT=1 one-off hatch. State is per session: every session starts in the mode, and CCGM_ADVISOR_AUTO=false opts out.
name: advisor-mode
